mysteries.title: The Annunciation
mysteries.scriptureText: Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you.
mysteries.meditation: The Angel Gabriel announces to Mary that she will become the Mother of God.

mysteries.title: The Visitation
mysteries.scriptureText: Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb.
mysteries.meditation: Mary visits her cousin Elizabeth who is with child in her old age.

mysteries.title: The Nativity
mysteries.scriptureText: She gave birth to her firstborn son and wrapped him in swaddling clothes.
mysteries.meditation: Jesus Christ is born in Bethlehem in a lowly stable.

mysteries.title: The Presentation
mysteries.scriptureText: My eyes have seen your salvation which you have prepared in the sight of all people.
mysteries.meditation: Mary and Joseph present the child Jesus in the Temple of Jerusalem.

mysteries.title: Finding in the Temple
mysteries.scriptureText: Did you not know that I must be in my Father's house?
mysteries.meditation: After three days of searching, Mary and Joseph find the boy Jesus in the Temple.

mysteries.title: The Baptism in the Jordan
mysteries.scriptureText: This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.
mysteries.meditation: John baptizes Jesus in the River Jordan as the heavens open.

mysteries.title: The Wedding at Cana
mysteries.scriptureText: Do whatever he tells you.
mysteries.meditation: At Mary's request, Jesus performs his first miracle turning water into wine.

mysteries.title: Proclamation of the Kingdom
mysteries.scriptureText: Repent, and believe in the gospel.
mysteries.meditation: Jesus preaches the Good News, calling all people to conversion.

mysteries.title: The Transfiguration
mysteries.scriptureText: His face shone like the sun, and his clothes became white as light.
mysteries.meditation: Jesus reveals His divine glory on Mount Tabor before Peter, James, and John.

mysteries.title: Institution of the Eucharist
mysteries.scriptureText: Take, eat; this is my body.
mysteries.meditation: At the Last Supper, Jesus gives us His Body and Blood in the Holy Eucharist.

mysteries.title: The Agony in the Garden
mysteries.scriptureText: Father, if you are willing, remove this chalice; yet not my will, but yours be done.
mysteries.meditation: Jesus prays under the olive trees of Gethsemane, sweating drops of blood.

mysteries.title: The Scourging at the Pillar
mysteries.scriptureText: Pilate took Jesus and had him scourged.
mysteries.meditation: Jesus is bound to a pillar and brutally whipped for our offenses.

mysteries.title: The Crowning with Thorns
mysteries.scriptureText: Platting a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head.
mysteries.meditation: Soldiers mock the King of Kings with a thorny crown and purple cloak.

mysteries.title: The Carrying of the Cross
mysteries.scriptureText: Bearing his own cross, he went forth to the place of the Skull.
mysteries.meditation: Jesus carries the heavy wooden cross along the Via Dolorosa to Calvary.

mysteries.title: The Crucifixion
mysteries.scriptureText: Father, into your hands I commend my spirit.
mysteries.meditation: Jesus dies on the Cross after three hours of agony to redeem humanity.

mysteries.title: The Resurrection
mysteries.scriptureText: He has risen; he is not here.
mysteries.meditation: Christ gloriously triumphs over death and rises on the third day.

mysteries.title: The Ascension
mysteries.scriptureText: As they were looking on, he was lifted up, and a cloud took him out of their sight.
mysteries.meditation: Forty days after Easter, Jesus ascends body and soul into Heaven.

mysteries.title: Descent of the Holy Spirit
mysteries.scriptureText: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit.
mysteries.meditation: The Holy Spirit descends as tongues of fire upon the Apostles and Mary.

mysteries.title: The Assumption
mysteries.scriptureText: Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.
mysteries.meditation: The Blessed Virgin Mary is taken body and soul into heavenly glory.

mysteries.title: Coronation of Mary
mysteries.scriptureText: A woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.
mysteries.meditation: Mary is crowned by the Holy Trinity as Queen of Heaven and Earth.

mysteries.title: 1st Salutation: Choir of Seraphim
mysteries.scriptureText: Above him stood the seraphim... Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of hosts.
mysteries.meditation: By the intercession of St. Michael and the heavenly Choir of Seraphim, may the Lord make us worthy of the flame of perfect charity.

mysteries.title: 2nd Salutation: Choir of Cherubim
mysteries.scriptureText: He placed at the east of Eden cherubim and a flaming sword.
mysteries.meditation: By the intercession of St. Michael and the Choir of Cherubim, may the Lord grant us grace to forsake evil and advance in Christian perfection.

mysteries.title: 3rd Salutation: Choir of Thrones
mysteries.scriptureText: For in him all things were created, in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible.
mysteries.meditation: By the intercession of St. Michael and the celestial Choir of Thrones, may the Lord infuse into our souls a true spirit of humility.

mysteries.title: 4th Salutation: Choir of Dominions
mysteries.scriptureText: Far above all rule and authority and power and dominion.
mysteries.meditation: By the intercession of St. Michael and the Choir of Dominions, may the Lord give us grace to master our senses and overcome unruly passions.

mysteries.title: 5th Salutation: Choir of Powers
mysteries.scriptureText: With angels, authorities, and powers subject to him.
mysteries.meditation: By the intercession of St. Michael and the celestial Choir of Powers, may the Lord protect our souls against the snares of the enemy.

mysteries.title: 6th Salutation: Choir of Virtues
mysteries.scriptureText: Nor angels nor rulers... will be able to separate us from the love of God.
mysteries.meditation: By the intercession of St. Michael and the Choir of Virtues, may the Lord keep us from falling into temptation.

mysteries.title: 7th Salutation: Choir of Principalities
mysteries.scriptureText: Now war arose in heaven, Michael and his angels fighting against the dragon.
mysteries.meditation: By the intercession of St. Michael and the Choir of Principalities, may God fill our souls with a true and sincere spirit of obedience.

mysteries.title: 8th Salutation: Choir of Archangels
mysteries.scriptureText: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a cry of command, with the voice of an archangel.
mysteries.meditation: By the intercession of St. Michael and the celestial Choir of Archangels, may the Lord grant us perseverance in faith and good works, that we may attain the glory of Paradise.

mysteries.title: 9th Salutation: Choir of Angels
mysteries.scriptureText: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
mysteries.meditation: By the intercession of St. Michael and the celestial Choir of Angels, may the Lord grant us to be protected by them in this life and conducted hereafter into eternal glory.

mysteries.title: 1st Decade: For All Sinners
mysteries.scriptureText: Father, forgive them, for they know not what they do.
mysteries.meditation: I offer You the Body and Blood, Soul and Divinity of Your Dearly Beloved Son, Our Lord Jesus Christ, in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world.

mysteries.title: 2nd Decade: For Priests & Consecrated Souls
mysteries.scriptureText: For their sake I consecrate myself, that they also may be sanctified in truth.
mysteries.meditation: We offer this decade for the holiness, strength, and fidelity of our bishops, priests, and consecrated religious.

mysteries.title: 3rd Decade: For Devout & Faithful Souls
mysteries.scriptureText: Well done, good and faithful servant. Enter into the joy of your master.
mysteries.meditation: We offer this decade for all faithful souls who bring comfort to the wounded Heart of Jesus through daily fidelity.

mysteries.title: 4th Decade: For Those in Spiritual Darkness
mysteries.scriptureText: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
mysteries.meditation: We offer this decade for those who do not believe in God and those who do not yet know the radiant love of Christ.

mysteries.title: 5th Decade: For the Holy Souls in Purgatory
mysteries.scriptureText: It is a holy and wholesome thought to pray for the dead, that they may be loosed from sins.
mysteries.meditation: We submerge the suffering souls into the ocean of Christ's Blood and Water, that their purification may be hastened.

mysteries.title: 1st Mystery: The Betrothal & Faith of Joseph
mysteries.scriptureText: Joseph, son of David, do not fear to take Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
mysteries.meditation: Joseph accepts his sacred calling with serene faith, protecting Mary with chaste and steadfast love.

mysteries.title: 2nd Mystery: The Nativity of Jesus in Bethlehem
mysteries.scriptureText: And she gave birth to her firstborn son and wrapped him in swaddling clothes and laid him in a manger.
mysteries.meditation: Joseph adores the Infant King in the humble manger, providing for the Holy Family with loving care.

mysteries.title: 3rd Mystery: The Circumcision & Holy Name
mysteries.scriptureText: He was called Jesus, the name given by the angel before he was conceived.
mysteries.meditation: Joseph confers the saving Name of Jesus, participating in the first shedding of Christ's precious blood.

mysteries.title: 4th Mystery: The Flight into Egypt
mysteries.scriptureText: And he rose and took the child and his mother by night and departed to Egypt.
mysteries.meditation: In prompt obedience, Joseph rises in the night to shield the Christ Child from Herod's persecution.

mysteries.title: 5th Mystery: The Hidden Life at Nazareth
mysteries.scriptureText: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth and was submissive to them.
mysteries.meditation: In quiet carpenter work, Joseph guides and provides for Jesus as He grows in wisdom, age, and grace.

mysterySets.name: Chaplet of Seven Sorrows of Mary

mysteries.title: 1st Sorrow: The Prophecy of Simeon
mysteries.scriptureText: And a sword will pierce through your own soul also.
mysteries.meditation: Simeon foretells the bitter passion of Christ, wounding Mary's maternal heart from the days of His infancy.

mysteries.title: 2nd Sorrow: The Flight into Egypt
mysteries.scriptureText: Flee to Egypt, and remain there until I tell you, for Herod is about to search for the child to destroy him.
mysteries.meditation: Mary endures hardship, poverty, and exile in a strange land to protect her newborn Child from death.

mysteries.title: 3rd Sorrow: The Loss of Jesus in Jerusalem
mysteries.scriptureText: Son, why have you treated us so? Behold, your father and I have been searching for you in great distress.
mysteries.meditation: For three days of anguish, Mary searches for the Boy Jesus, feeling the deep spiritual ache of His absence.

mysteries.title: 4th Sorrow: Mary Meets Jesus on Calvary Way
mysteries.scriptureText: A great multitude followed him, including women who mourned and lamented him.
mysteries.meditation: Mother and Son exchange a sorrowful gaze amidst the scourging wounds and weight of the heavy cross.

mysteries.title: 5th Sorrow: The Crucifixion & Death of Jesus
mysteries.scriptureText: Standing by the cross of Jesus were his mother and his mother's sister.
mysteries.meditation: Mary stands faithfully beneath the cross for three agonizing hours until her divine Son yields His spirit.

mysteries.title: 6th Sorrow: Piercing of Side & Pietà
mysteries.scriptureText: One of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and at once there came out blood and water.
mysteries.meditation: Mary receives the lifeless, scourged Body of Jesus into her lap, bathing His sacred wounds with tears.

mysteries.title: 7th Sorrow: The Burial of Jesus in the Tomb
mysteries.scriptureText: They laid Jesus there, and rolled a stone to the entrance of the tomb.
mysteries.meditation: Mary watches the heavy stone seal the holy sepulcher, returning home in lonely faith awaiting the Resurrection.

mysteries.title: 1st Mystery: The Incarnation of Divine Love
mysteries.scriptureText: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son.
mysteries.meditation: The Sacred Heart beats from all eternity with tender, merciful affection for every soul.

mysteries.title: 2nd Mystery: The Agony of the Sacred Heart
mysteries.scriptureText: And being in agony he prayed more earnestly; and his sweat became like great drops of blood.
mysteries.meditation: In Gethsemane, the Heart of Jesus suffered excruciating sorrow over the sins and indifference of mankind.

mysteries.title: 3rd Mystery: The Wounded Side of Christ
mysteries.scriptureText: One of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and at once there came out blood and water.
mysteries.meditation: From the pierced Heart of Jesus gushed forth the living fountain of the Sacraments and Church.

mysteries.title: 4th Mystery: The Eucharistic Heart
mysteries.scriptureText: Take, eat; this is my body.
mysteries.meditation: In the Blessed Sacrament, the Heart of Jesus remains present with us day and night, waiting for our adoration.

mysteries.title: 5th Mystery: The Triumphant Reign of Love
mysteries.scriptureText: Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength!
mysteries.meditation: The Sacred Heart reigns victorious over sin and death, drawing all hearts to His eternal kingdom.

mysteries.title: 1st Shedding: The Circumcision of Jesus
mysteries.scriptureText: And at the end of eight days, when he was circumcised, he was called Jesus.
mysteries.meditation: The Divine Infant sheds His first drops of Blood for our salvation, submitting to the Law in perfect obedience.

mysteries.title: 2nd Shedding: The Agony in the Garden of Gethsemane
mysteries.scriptureText: And being in agony he prayed more earnestly; and his sweat became like great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
mysteries.meditation: Under the crushing weight of the sins of all humanity, the Savior bleeds from every pore in holy surrender.
mysteries.fruitOfMystery: Conformity to the Will of God

mysteries.title: 3rd Shedding: The Scourging at the Pillar
mysteries.scriptureText: Then Pilate took Jesus and scourged him.
mysteries.meditation: In deep reparation for our sins of the flesh, Jesus offers His sacred Body to brutal scourges until drenched in Blood.

mysteries.title: 4th Shedding: The Crowning with Thorns
mysteries.scriptureText: And twisting together a crown of thorns, they put it on his head and put a reed in his right hand.
mysteries.meditation: Sharp thorns pierce the venerable Head of Christ, the King of Glory, making His Blood stream down His sacred Face.

mysteries.title: 5th Shedding: The Carrying of the Cross
mysteries.scriptureText: And bearing his own cross, he went out to the place called The Place of a Skull.
mysteries.meditation: The heavy cross tears open the wound on Jesus' shoulder as He leaves a crimson trail of Blood along the Via Dolorosa.

mysteries.title: 6th Shedding: The Crucifixion of Our Lord
mysteries.scriptureText: And when they came to the place that is called The Skull, there they crucified him.
mysteries.meditation: Iron nails tear through the hands and feet of our Redeemer, releasing the cleansing stream that redeems the cosmos.

mysteries.title: 7th Shedding: The Piercing of the Sacred Side
mysteries.scriptureText: One of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and at once there came out blood and water.
mysteries.meditation: The soldier's lance opens the infinite treasury of the Sacred Heart, giving birth to the Church and Sacraments.

mysteries.title: 1st Joy: The Annunciation
mysteries.scriptureText: Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you.
mysteries.meditation: Mary rejoices with sublime humility as the Holy Spirit overshadows her and the Word becomes Flesh.

mysteries.title: 2nd Joy: The Visitation to Saint Elizabeth
mysteries.scriptureText: When Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, the baby leaped in her womb.
mysteries.meditation: Mary's heart overflows with jubilation as she proclaims the Magnificat in service to her cousin.

mysteries.title: 3rd Joy: The Nativity of Jesus in Bethlehem
mysteries.scriptureText: And she gave birth to her firstborn son and wrapped him in swaddling clothes.
mysteries.meditation: Mary gazes in adoration upon the newborn Savior, holding the Light of the World in maternal peace.

mysteries.title: 4th Joy: The Adoration of the Magi
mysteries.scriptureText: They saw the child with Mary his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him.
mysteries.meditation: Mary rejoices as Gentile kings from distant lands offer gold, frankincense, and myrrh to the King of Kings.

mysteries.title: 5th Joy: The Finding of the Boy Jesus in the Temple
mysteries.scriptureText: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting among the teachers.
mysteries.meditation: The agonizing sorrow of loss transforms into radiant bliss as Mary and Joseph find Jesus in His Father's House.
mysteries.fruitOfMystery: Joy in Seeking and Finding Christ

mysteries.title: 6th Joy: The Resurrection of Our Lord
mysteries.scriptureText: He has risen; he is not here. See the place where they laid him.
mysteries.meditation: Traditional piety contemplates the triumphant Risen Christ appearing first to His Blessed Mother in glory.
mysteries.fruitOfMystery: Joy in the Victory of Eternal Life

mysteries.title: 7th Joy: The Assumption and Coronation of Our Lady
mysteries.scriptureText: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet.
mysteries.meditation: Mary is assumed body and soul into heaven and crowned Queen of angels and saints by the Blessed Trinity.

mysterySets.name: Chaplet for the Holy Souls in Purgatory

mysteries.title: 1st Mystery: The Souls Longing for the Beatific Vision
mysteries.scriptureText: Out of the depths I cry to you, O Lord! O Lord, hear my voice!
mysteries.meditation: We pray for the holy souls who ache with profound love to gaze upon the Face of God in eternal peace.

mysteries.title: 2nd Mystery: The Purifying Love of God
mysteries.scriptureText: If anyone's work is burned up, he will suffer loss, though he himself will be saved, but only as through fire.
mysteries.meditation: We offer our prayers and suffrages to relieve the suffering souls as divine love cleanses away every imperfection.

mysteries.title: 3rd Mystery: The Consolation of Holy Angels
mysteries.scriptureText: And there appeared to him an angel from heaven, strengthening him.
mysteries.meditation: We pray that Guardian Angels and Saint Michael visit and console the holy souls with heavenly dew and grace.

mysteries.title: 4th Mystery: The Maternal Intercession of Our Lady
mysteries.scriptureText: When Jesus saw his mother and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to his mother, 'Woman, behold, your son!'
mysteries.meditation: We invoke the Mother of Mercy, who descends into purgatory to comfort her children and lead them toward light.

mysteries.title: 5th Mystery: The Triumphant Entrance into Paradise
mysteries.scriptureText: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes, and death shall be no more, neither shall there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain.
mysteries.meditation: We rejoice with the liberated souls admitted into the banquet of the Lamb to intercede for us for all eternity.

mysteries.title: 1st Mystery: The Sacred Wound of the Left Foot
mysteries.scriptureText: They have pierced my hands and feet; I can count all my bones.
mysteries.meditation: Through the merits of the sacred Wound in Christ's left foot, we implore forgiveness for all steps taken on paths of sin.

mysteries.title: 2nd Mystery: The Sacred Wound of the Right Foot
mysteries.scriptureText: He was pierced for our transgressions; he was crushed for our iniquities.
mysteries.meditation: By the sacred Wound in Christ's right foot, we ask for grace to walk steadfastly in the footsteps of the Gospel.

mysteries.title: 3rd Mystery: The Sacred Wound of the Left Hand
mysteries.scriptureText: What are these wounds on your back? He will answer: The wounds I received in the house of my friends.
mysteries.meditation: By the holy Wound in Christ's left hand, we plead for deliverance from all spiritual sluggishness and pride.

mysteries.title: 4th Mystery: The Sacred Wound of the Right Hand
mysteries.scriptureText: Put your finger here, and see my hands... Do not disbelieve, but believe.
mysteries.meditation: Through the holy Wound of Christ's right hand, we pray for the sanctification of our families, priests, and religious.

mysteries.title: 5th Mystery: The Sacred Wound of the Pierced Heart and Side
mysteries.scriptureText: One of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and at once there came out blood and water.
mysteries.meditation: We take refuge inside the open wound of Jesus' Side, the burning furnace of love and divine mercy.

mysteries.title: 1st Mystery: Saint Anne and the Holy Matrimony
mysteries.scriptureText: An excellent wife who can find? She is far more precious than jewels.
mysteries.meditation: We honor the holy life and righteous prayers of Saints Joachim and Anne, blessed by God with unshakeable trust.

mysteries.title: 2nd Mystery: The Immaculate Conception of Mary
mysteries.scriptureText: Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you.
mysteries.meditation: Saint Anne gives birth to the Immaculate Mother of God, the dawn of our redemption and Ark of the Covenant.

mysteries.title: 3rd Mystery: The Grandmother of the Incarnate Word
mysteries.scriptureText: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
mysteries.meditation: We contemplate Saint Anne cradling and teaching the Blessed Virgin Mary who bore the Savior of the world.
